title: fix(mcp): answer malformed request params as -32602 Invalid params naming the param
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9KACvtSQYX3ZKqWRb83L4mE)_
Fixes #29135

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：MCP 请求参数格式不对（如 `prompts/get` 不带 name、`tools/call` 传 `{}`）时，服务器现在回 JSON-RPC -32602「参数无效」，并用一句英文点名哪个参数错了（`params.name is required`），不再回 -32603「内部错误」加一段 Zod 原始 JSON。
- 为什么改：-32603 告诉调用方「服务器坏了」，AI 代理会当成可重试错误反复重发一个永远不会成功的请求；开发者看到的是一堆 Zod 内部结构，而不是一句话。
- 风险与回滚：同样的请求照样被拒，只是错误码和文字变了；工具自身的参数校验（如 `validate_expression` 的 site 枚举）和处理函数内部抛出的错误都不受影响。回滚即回退本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/mcp/src/request-params.ts`（唯一的接缝，读 SDK 未公开的请求处理表，缺失时构造即报错）、`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` 两处建服务器的调用点、`packages/mcp/src/request-params.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/request-params.test.ts`，预期 7 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- New `packages/mcp/src/request-params.ts` with `createPlatformMcpServer(...)`, now the only place the platform builds an MCP `McpServer`. Both transports use it: the long-lived (stdio) server in the `MCPServerRuntime` constructor and the per-request Streamable HTTP server in `handleHttpRequest`.
- It wraps every request dispatcher the SDK's low-level `Server` holds, the ones the SDK installs in its own constructor (`initialize`, `ping`) and every later one (`tools/call`, `prompts/get`, `resources/read`, …). A ZodError thrown **synchronously** by a dispatcher is the method's request-schema parse (the SDK parses before it calls the async handler), and it is rethrown as `McpError(ErrorCode.InvalidParams, sentence)`. A ZodError raised inside a handler arrives as a rejected promise and keeps its own answer.
- Sentence: one plain-English clause per issue, joined with `; `: `params.name is required` (the value is absent), `params.name must be a string` (wrong type), `must be one of …` (enum or literal), `has unrecognized key(s): …`. Any other issue falls back to the shared `formatZodIssue` from `@objectstack/spec/shared`. `McpError` adds its own `MCP error -32602:` prefix.
- No new error code: -32602 is the JSON-RPC standard one the SDK already uses for its own invalid-params answers. No `packages/spec/**` edit, no lockfile change, no new gate.

## Why

The SDK's `Protocol.setRequestHandler` (measured on the installed `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 1.32.1, and unchanged in the latest 1.32.2) installs a closure that parses the request with the method's schema and rethrows the ZodError unchanged. A ZodError has no numeric `code`, so the protocol answers `-32603 Internal error` with the error's message, which is the serialised issue array. The SDK offers no public hook between that parse and the error answer, so the seam reads the protocol's `_requestHandlers` map. That is an SDK-internal field, so the seam checks it is there: if a later SDK renames it, server construction throws an error that names this function, and the -32603 answer does not come back silently.

Measured on base `0d6d4061` (in-process, same calls as the card):

| Request | Base | Head |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `prompts/get` `{}` (HTTP) | -32603, Zod issue array | -32602 `params.name is required` |
| `tools/call` `{}` (HTTP) | -32603, Zod issue array | -32602 `params.name is required` |
| `prompts/get` `{"name":42}` (HTTP) | -32603, Zod issue array | -32602 `params.name must be a string` |
| `tools/call` `{}` (stdio, long-lived server) | -32603, Zod issue array | -32602 `params.name is required` |
| control: `validate_expression` with `site: "nope"` | tool result `isError`, `MCP error -32602: Input validation error: …` | unchanged |

Clause-② measured: the same requests are refused on base and head (no request accepted on one side is refused on the other), so `no`. Only the error class and the message change.

## Tests

`packages/mcp/src/request-params.test.ts` (new, 7 cases):
- HTTP: `prompts/get` with no name, `tools/call` with `{}`, `prompts/get` with `name: 42`, and `initialize` with no `protocolVersion` (a handler the SDK installs in its own constructor). Each asserts `error.code === -32602` and the full message.
- stdio: `tools/call` with `{}` on the long-lived server over a real `StdioServerTransport`.
- Control: `validate_expression` with an unknown `site` keeps its tool-result answer.
- Negative pin: a ZodError thrown inside a handler keeps `-32603`.

No existing test was edited.

## Acceptance notes

- `resources/read` with malformed params: neither server in these tests registers resources, so it answers -32601 Method not found there. The seam is method-agnostic (it wraps the map, not a method list), and the `initialize` pin proves that a handler installed outside the platform's own registration is covered too.
- Upstream: the SDK could map the request-schema ZodError to InvalidParams itself; when it does, this seam can go. That is noted in the report's open questions, not filed.

## Verification

All readings at head `7bff29ad` unless noted.

- Discriminator widened (the guard also maps a ZodError that a handler rejects with): only `a ZodError thrown inside a handler keeps the -32603 answer` fails, `expected -32602 to be -32603`. 6 passed.

</details>
